messages:
deploybot: [DEPLOY-HOLD] Orbit rollout paused in eu-region. Reason: control-plane spikes -> increased 502s (kv-cache eviction). Holding all related slots and blocking new rollouts. Thread opened 1718007654.
jon.ops: seeing same in grafana, spike started ~15:12 UTC, errors from ingress -> kv read failure.
maria.sre: confirmed. Canary error rate went from 0.8% -> 6.2% after the recent kernel tweak.
camila.release: recommendation: pin canary back to v2026.03.20-rc3 and postpone remaining rollouts.
dinesh.eng: the change was the kvcache threshold bump in build 2026.03.21.33. Rolling back that binary is a straightforward requeue but will evict cache again on churn. How long do we want to pin?
alice.pm: important to surface to customers quickly. If we pin/rollback we should have a one-line note in release notes and status page.
jon.ops: SRE suggestion: soft-rollback canary to v2026.03.20-rc3, monitor for 10 minutes. If errors drop -> clear hold and requeue with staggered lanes. If not -> widen rollback.
maria.sre: I can run rollback. Command: `/deploy rollback orbit-canary --to v2026.03.20-rc3 --follow`
deploybot: Command accepted by deploybot. Starting rollback of orbit-canary -> v2026.03.20-rc3. Estimated time ~4m.
deploybot: Rollback completed. orbit-canary now at v2026.03.20-rc3. Observability: 502 rate dropping from 6.2% -> 1.1% in last 3m.
camila.release: good. I'll reschedule the eu change window by +2h to allow a postmortem and a cautious backfill. Propose new window: 2026-03-21 17:30Z.
jon.ops: +1 to the bump. Ops: set release pin for the orbit lane for 24h to prevent accidental requeue.
dinesh.eng: quick note: I opened PR #6742 to revert the kvcache threshold bump; will request review from infra. If accepted we can include the proper fix in the next patch.
alice.pm: I'll draft the release note blurb: "EU rollout paused due to transient control-plane errors after a kvcache threshold change; canary rolled back to v2026.03.20-rc3; working on root cause and follow-up patch." Anyone want to tweak?
maria.sre: looks good. I'll create incident INC-2026-045 and attach timelines and logs from 15:10-15:25 UTC.
deploybot: Note: All rollouts targeting eu-region are held until 2026-03-21T17:30Z or manual clearance by oncall. Use `/deploy hold-clear orbit eu` to override.
camila.release: scheduling a post-incident release review tomorrow 10:00am PT, invite sent to eng, sres, and product.
jon.ops: thanks everyone. If we see a regression after the backfill, we escalate to full rollback and notify customers via status-page.
alice.pm: I'll publish the brief note to the status channel and add the release hold reason in release logs.
dinesh.eng: tagging infra: @infra-team please review PR #6742 urgently.
maria.sre: closing thread once incident ticket has timeline + RCA. For now keeping the pinned hold in place. (:+1:)
